ICS 93.100MED 6New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard covers the design and construction of Funicular railways meant for the transportation of passengers and goods in separate cabins.2. REFERENCESThe Indian Standards listed in Annex ‘A’ contain provisions which through reference in the text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards.
